# Travel World

> Travel World is a luxury travel management company offering bespoke holidays, visa services, flights, hotels, and transfers for individuals and businesses worldwide. With 7+ years of experience, 241+ destinations, and 24,000+ happy travellers.

## About

Travel World specialises in end-to-end luxury travel management. We handle every detail — flights, hotels, visa applications, airport transfers, and curated itineraries — so travellers can focus on the experience. We serve both leisure travellers and corporate clients globally.

- Founded: 2017
- Destinations covered: 241+
- Happy travellers: 24,000+
- Services: Holiday packages, visa assistance, corporate travel, honeymoon packages, group tours, adventure travel

## Services

- **Holiday Packages**: Tailor-made itineraries for individuals, couples, families, and groups
- **Visa Services**: End-to-end visa assistance for USA, UK, Schengen, Canada, Australia, Dubai, Singapore, Japan, and 50+ countries
- **Corporate Travel**: Managed travel programmes for businesses — flights, accommodation, ground transport
- **Honeymoon Packages**: Romantic getaways to Maldives, Bali, Paris, Santorini, and more
- **Group Tours**: Curated group travel experiences with expert guides
- **Adventure Travel**: Trekking, safaris, and expedition packages

## Popular Destinations

Asia: Maldives, Bali, Thailand, Singapore, Japan, Dubai, Hong Kong, South Korea, Taiwan, China, Malaysia, Philippines, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, Cambodia, Georgia, Uzbekistan, Oman, Jordan
Europe: Paris, Rome, Venice, Santorini, Mykonos, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Prague, Lisbon, Iceland, Dubrovnik, Zermatt, Switzerland
Africa: Tanzania, Cape Town, Zanzibar, Kenya, Cairo, Seychelles, Mauritius, Marrakech
Americas: New York, Cancun, Costa Rica, Peru, Rio de Janeiro, Patagonia
Oceania: Australia, New Zealand, Fiji, Bora Bora, Sydney

## Visa Services

Travel World provides complete visa assistance including document preparation, application submission, and status tracking for:
- USA Tourist & Business Visa
- UK Standard Visitor Visa
- Schengen Visa (all 27 countries)
- Canada Tourist Visa
- Australia Tourist Visa (ETA & Subclass 600)
- Dubai Tourist Visa
- Singapore Tourist Visa
- Japan Tourist Visa
- And 50+ more countries
